focus: Reliable recovery and trustworthy acceptance; SHELXT is a reference, not an outperformance target.
scope: Same exposed fourteen COD cases with identical numeric HKL values, cell/element and matched Laue/centring priors. Exact group, counts and coordinates withheld. No reference-based output selection.

wheel_runtime_identity.validation: Repeat the complete installed-wheel Python suite on the final payload; do not substitute earlier full-suite results.

source_reconstruction.native_full_archive_all_features_check: passed after exact full-source hash verification
source_reconstruction.smoke: passed in fresh NumPy-only environment, optional numerical imports blocked

exclusions.reason: Initial launch overlapped final source-archive compression; partial run excluded from normal timings and retained as diagnostic. Rerun identical frozen inputs after archive completion.

timing_limits: Sequential non-interleaved stages on a shared Apple M4 Pro desktop. Native arm64 four phase workers; SHELXT 2018/2 x86_64 under Rosetta with four/ten workers. No general ranking or cross-platform guarantee. Extra diagnostics use eight workers.

cleanup.preserved: Every source snapshot, prediction, failed/partial run, grading record, executable, wheel, raw benchmark estimate, log and original dataset; other worktrees and shared caches untouched.
